```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gapminder)
```

```{r}
install.packages("gapminder")
```

```{r}
glimpse(gapminder)

```

```{r}
gapminder_data <- gapminder %>%
  rename(
    life_expectancy = lifeExp,
    population = pop,
    gdp_per_capita = gdpPercap
  )
```

```{r}
gapminder_2007 <- gapminder_data %>%
  filter(year == 2007)
ggplot(
  data = gapminder_2007,
  mapping = aes(
    x = gdp_per_capita,
    y = life_expectancy
  )
) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = gapminder_2007,
  mapping = aes(
    x = gdp_per_capita,
    y = life_expectancy,
    color = continent
  )
) + geom_point()
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = gapminder_2007,
  mapping = aes(
    x = gdp_per_capita,
    y = life_expectancy
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.7drop
  )
```
